notes: FAIL means a specifically named primary curriculum topic is absent from the authored manuscript/reader, not that its internal row is missing.
HOLD means evidence or qualification is insufficient, not proof of content error.
The published 84-row internal taxonomy is an authoring design; this register cannot certify the negative space of all VI-VIII and older IX/X versions.

issues.source: CBSE Class X Science 2026-27 Unit I Carbon and its Compounds; PDF physical p4 (zero-index), PDF printed p5
issues.evidence: The official functional-group summary names halogens alongside alcohols, ketones and aldehydes; C11 author reader and textbook contain no halo-, chloromethane, fluoro- or halogen-group discussion. Carbon substitution with Cl2 elsewhere is not a full lesson on the halogen functional group.
issues.fix: Amend C11.05 Core1A with halogen substitution as structural functional-group identity and class-appropriate haloalkane examples; add at least one independent Core1B REPRESENT / MODEL task and a misconception boundary. Preserve all existing C11 tasks; do not claim official source-question identity.
issues.acceptance: Exact CBSE item mapped to new reader subsection, source-appropriate explanation and task, negative test for missing halogen group, new independent academic review.

issues.source: CBSE Class X Science 2026-27 Unit V Natural Resources, Our Environment, PDF physical p5 (zero-index)
issues.evidence: CBSE explicitly lists ozone depletion. C14 textbook/reader/core1b contain no ozone depletion, chlorofluorocarbon, CFC or chlorine-catalysed depletion model. C14.01 contrasts stratospheric protective ozone with ground-level pollution but does not teach depletion.
issues.fix: Add complete age-appropriate stratospheric ozone-depletion cause/effect, responsible ozone-depleting chemicals, UV protection and misconceptions about ground-level ozone, with carefully bounded chemistry and one changed-condition transfer. Link C14.01 or add a stable subtopic only through Agent A schema governance.
issues.acceptance: Primary curriculum clause linked to a real explanatory lesson and Core1B task; independent scientific review on reaction mechanism and environmental claims.

issues.source: CBSE Class X Unit V waste production and solutions
